run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout since 2026-11-16T12:21:57Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert is firing because checkout's PlaceOrder calls fail on the outbound shipping-quote hop. Checkout's own error spans for oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (and its child 'HTTP POST' client span) carry the exact text 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400' with rpc.grpc.status_code 13. Per the supplied parent references, that failing HTTP POST is a child of prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart and the parent of the shipping server span '/get-quote', which completed in 31-469 us with no child 'POST quote' call - so shipping's /get-quote endpoint answered with the 400 before shipping invoked its quote dependency. The magnitudes match: over 12:25:00-12:45:00 checkout PlaceOrder spans were 586.7 ERROR vs 954.9 UNSET, shipping '/get-quote' 1541.5 vs shipping 'POST quote' 954.9, and in each 5-minute bucket the (get-quote - POST quote) difference equals the checkout error count (70, 134.4, 146.7, 107.8, 140, 32.2, 77.8 vs 67, 134.4, 148.9, 110, 138.9, 32.2, 76.7). The error text's mention of the email service is not corroborated: email's 'POST /send_order_confirmation' span count (953.8) equals the successful order count (954.9) and sampled email spans record http.status_code 200. Shipping's visible log lines in the sampled slices contain only 'Requesting quote', 'Sending Quote' and 'Tracking ID Created', and no line appears at the start of the failing /get-quote span. Checkout, shipping, email and quote run stock ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3 images with consistent addresses; all 21 otel-demo deployments are 1/1 available/ready and all pods Running/Ready with 0 restarts; the flagd ConfigMap read after the window shows all fault flags 'off'. The deepest object the evidence reaches is the shipping Deployment, whose /get-quote endpoint rejects roughly 38% of checkout's quote requests with HTTP 400; which field or rule triggers that rejection is unresolved because request/response bodies are not observable and shipping logs nothing for those requests.

claims.text: Checkout's error telemetry is confined to two operations: in 12:25:00-12:45:00 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' STATUS_CODE_ERROR increased 586.67 and 'HTTP POST' STATUS_CODE_ERROR increased 586.67, while 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' STATUS_CODE_UNSET increased 954.87.

The failing checkout spans carry the exact diagnostic text 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400' with error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=13 (span f87dd56e45d7bf38 of trace fabf30c40bb674e79e93dd78836bb231; span 3eb00ad2ecdb18e6 of trace c2dfe80fa2f1b056337b23fdb64b35dc).

By the supplied parent references the failing checkout 'HTTP POST' client span is a child of prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart and the parent of the shipping server span '/get-quote'; in trace c2dfe80fa2f1b056337b23fdb64b35dc that POST lasted 1259 us while shipping '/get-quote' lasted 61 us, and in trace fabf30c40bb674e79e93dd78836bb231 826 us vs 469 us, so the outbound POST that failed was served by shipping's /get-quote.

Sub-500us shipping '/get-quote' spans occur only inside traces whose checkout 'HTTP POST' and 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' spans are errors: across the 5 sampled traces for '/get-quote' max_duration=500us in 12:21:57-12:45:00, each shows 5/5 error rows for the checkout HTTP POST and PlaceOrder spans, with '/get-quote' durations of 31-469 us.

Failing quote requests never reach the quote service: over 12:25:00-12:45:00 shipping '/get-quote' increased 1541.54 while shipping client span 'POST quote' increased 954.87 and quote's 'POST /getquote' increased 953.85; the per-bucket difference (353.3-285.6, 358.9-224.4, 348.9-200, 338.9-228.9, 354.4-215.6, 258.9-226.7, 326.7-250) matches the checkout PlaceOrder error increases.

The email service was not the failing hop: its 'POST /send_order_confirmation' span count (953.85 per 20 min) equals the successful PlaceOrder count (954.87), and sampled email spans (ea4b58b50f2f5c07, 29a33d3ec8e17ad4, 1c6f6333d2880d9c) record http.status_code 200.

In the shipping log slices delivered for 12:26:01.706-12:26:36.895 and 12:26:34.12-12:26:36.895 every line is one of 'Requesting quote', 'Sending Quote' or 'Tracking ID Created' (9 lines in the narrow slice, all three message types).

Within those delivered shipping log slices there is no line at 12:26:36.586, the start of the failing '/get-quote' span in trace fabf30c40bb674e79e93dd78836bb231, while normal triples appear at 12:26:36.353, 12:26:36.355/36.412 and 12:26:36.889-36.895.

The quote service is only invoked for the requests that succeed: its logs contain only 'Calculated quote' lines, its operations ('POST /getquote', 'calculate-quote', '{closure}') carry no error status, and it made 953.85 calls per 20 min against 954.87 successful PlaceOrder spans.

Checkout's application log for a failing PlaceOrder stops after '[PlaceOrder]' at 12:26:36.564663Z, while a successful PlaceOrder seconds later continues with 'payment went through', 'order placed', 'order confirmation email sent to "steve@example.com"' and 'Successful to write message' at 12:26:36.89-12:26:36.99Z, locating the failure before payment, order persistence and email.

Frontend is affected by the same failure: its spans 'POST /api/checkout', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' each increased 584.62 with STATUS_CODE_ERROR in 12:25:00-12:45:00, and span 4a3fe14ef72927ff records error=true, http.status_code=500 and grpc.error_message '13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400'.

In the sampled failing traces the load-generator 'POST' span (3f0b74180990d21e) and the frontend-proxy 'ingress' span (c10b8546c396e679) carry error=true and http.status_code=500, so those requests also failed at the client and proxy tiers.

No ERROR-status series was returned for shipping, email, quote, cart, currency or product-catalog in 12:25:00-12:45:00; the services with ERROR series were checkout 1173.33, frontend 2206.15, frontend-proxy 29847.18, ad 1.04, recommendation 2.05, fraud-detection 1.04, payment 0 and accounting 0.

The affected workloads are up and stable: all 21 otel-demo deployments report desired=available=ready=updated=1, and all 21 pods are Running and Ready with restart count 0 (including checkout-5dccddf8bb-vh65b and shipping-75d58f5d84-kgmz9).

The checkout, shipping, email and quote deployments use standard images ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-{checkout,shipping,email,quote} with consistent addresses EMAIL_ADDR=http://email:8080, SHIPPING_ADDR=http://shipping:8080 and QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080, and the corresponding Services expose port 8080/targetPort 8080 to selectors opentelemetry.io/name=<service>.

The flagd-config ConfigMap read after the window has every fault flag (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) at defaultVariant 'off' / 0.

The only Kubernetes events in otel-demo are the load-generator replacement submitted from 12:46:03 onward (Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started, 'Created pod: load-generator-7d5756fbd9-zzj4z', 'Deleted pod: load-generator-c7cbc4c99-xlnk2', Scaled up/down replica sets) - a controller rollout after the alert, with no Evicted/OOMKilled/Unhealthy/Failed events.

Checkout's trace series have no samples before the alert: a count of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout"} over 11:21:57-12:21:57 returns a single sample at 12:21:57, so error onset and any pre-incident baseline cannot be established from this data.

Proximate cause: the shipping Deployment's /get-quote endpoint rejects roughly 38% of checkout's quote requests with HTTP 400 before calling the quote service, and checkout turns those 400 responses into 'shipping quote failure: ... got 400' and PlaceOrder error spans. Supported by the parent-referenced checkout POST -> shipping /get-quote edge, the 31-469 us shipping spans with no child 'POST quote' call, and the exact match between per-bucket (get-quote - POST quote) differences and checkout error counts.

The trigger of shipping's 400 is a per-request data/validation condition (for example the item or currency content of the quote request checkout builds), not an infrastructure fault: shipping's visible log lines for these requests show only its normal quote messages, its pods are Ready with 0 restarts, and the rejection share varies by bucket (about 12% to 42%). Request bodies and the 400 response body are not observable, so this is unconfirmed.

The 'email service' wording in checkout's error text is a mislabel of the failing hop rather than a real email failure: the parent references place the failed POST on shipping's /get-quote, email's spans are 200s at the success rate, and no email trace with error=true or tag http.status_code=400 was returned in the window.

Rejected: pod crash, OOM or eviction in the call path. All otel-demo pods are Running/Ready with restart count 0, all deployments are 1/1, and the only window events are the load-generator rollout from 12:46:03 (SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete, Scaled up/down) with no Evicted, OOMKilled or Unhealthy events.

Rejected as the cause of the alert: the load-generator pod replacement. It happened after the alert started at 12:21:57 and the failure pattern persisted afterwards - the 12:51:57-12:56:57 bucket still shows 77.78 PlaceOrder error spans against 253.33 unset.

Against a network/DNS/transport failure to the quote service: in the failing requests shipping produced no 'POST quote' client span at all, whereas successful requests do (954.87 'POST quote' spans against 953.85 quote server spans), and shipping returned a fast server span (31-469 us) - behaviour of an early rejection inside shipping, not a timed-out or failed outbound call.

Capture one failing quote request end to end (checkout's request body for SHIPPING_ADDR/get-quote and shipping's 400 response body) and compare it with a succeeding one; enable request-level logging on shipping's /get-quote validation path, since no logging for the rejected requests was observed in the delivered slices.

Review the checkout quote helper's error string, which names the email service for a shipping-quote POST failure; the misleading text sends responders to the email service even though email served 200s at the success rate.

Locate the RequestErrorRate alert rule in the Alertmanager/Prometheus configuration, since the queried Prometheus returned no rules, so the measured 0.2 value and its evaluation window can be reproduced; the first observed 5-minute bucket ratio (70 PlaceOrder error spans vs 284.44 unset, about 0.198) is of the same order.

gaps: The Prometheus rule listing returned no_data (no rules), so the RequestErrorRate expression, threshold and evaluation window behind Alertmanager's 0.2 annotation are unknown.
Checkout trace metrics contain no samples before 12:21:57, so the onset of the error condition relative to the 12:11:48 pod provisioning cannot be bounded and no pre-incident baseline exists.

The filtered shipping log query for error|fail|400|warn|exception and a filter-exclusion query over shipping's logs both returned no_data, and a frontend log query returned no_data with filter 'not_run' - these absences are unknown, not proof that no error lines were written.
Email's log streams contained 0 bytes for both current and previous instances, so email is cleared only by its span data, not by its logs.
The bodies of checkout's quote POST requests and of shipping's 400 responses are not observable, so the specific validation producing the 400 is unverified.
Shipping's spans carry no status tags (not_recorded), so shipping's own telemetry cannot confirm the response codes it returned; the 400 is known only from checkout's client span and its error text.

frontend-proxy shows 29453.33 error 'ingress' spans per 20 minutes, far more than the ~587 failing checkouts; those proxy errors are unexplained by this evidence and were not attributed to this cause.
The flagd ConfigMap was read after the window and the flagd pod produced no log lines, so the flags in effect during 12:21-13:01 are unknown; all flags read 'off' only after the window.
The load-generator's own user_checkout_* span series were not present in the queried metric set (that query returned no_data), so the client-side flow names seen in traces are not quantified.
next_steps: Capture and compare a failing and a succeeding POST /get-quote request (headers and JSON body) from checkout, plus shipping's 400 response body.
Add temporary logging around shipping's /get-quote request decoding/validation path and re-run the load generator to see which field is rejected.
Check whether failing checkouts correlate with specific cart contents or currency values by logging user currency and item count in checkout's quote helper.
Retrieve the RequestErrorRate rule definition from the Alertmanager/Prometheus configuration that generated the alert to confirm the 0.2 calculation and its window.
